name: Strömbom 2014
paper_title: Solving the shepherding problem: heuristics for herding autonomous, interacting agents
authors: D. Strömbom, R. P. Mann, A. M. Wilson, S. Hailes, A. J. Morton, D. J. T. Sumpter, A. J. King
journal: Journal of The Royal Society Interface
mechanism: Single shepherd adaptively switches between Collect (gather stragglers) and Drive (push flock to goal) based on flock cohesion threshold f(N) = r_a × N^(2/3).

assignment_modes.label: Collect: herder to outlier sheep being gathered.
Drive: herder to stand-off behind the flock.
